But further progress depends on addressing food waste, plastic films, textiles, electrical products and complex packaging.

These streams are harder to collect, separate and process, while markets for some recovered materials, where waste is reused, remain

Another reason recycling have not climbed as high as

is that people cannot recycle materials that councils do not collect. To help people recycle more it is important to eliminate confusing labels, redesign packaging that was never designed to be recycled or create new markets for recovered materials.

Burning not burying

It’s important to note that landfill
is also an important environmental achievement, and in Scotland, for instance, landfill use has declined – down 82.5% since 2011 – although incineration has increased. In 2024 1.86 million tonnes was

But the UK is
burning what it no longer wants to bury. In 2024, 63 energy-from-waste plants burned 16.8 million tonnes of residual waste. Since 2024, there are ten incinerators under

reading.title: 主旨、理解与信息定位
reading.instruction: 阅读原文后回答 5 道选择题：1 道主旨、1 道内容理解、1 道段落细节、2 道信息定位。段落细节题以题干指定段落为准。

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the overall focus of this article?
options: Comparing Scotland and Wales reveals policy choices that influence recycling performance.
Condor conservation illustrates the importance of deciding whose voices shape species protection.
Past El Niño erosion shows why California's vulnerable coastline remains at risk.
A long-standing vision of energy efficiency offers a useful perspective on modern electrification.
questions.explanation: 把标题与全文各段的中心内容连起来判断主旨，避免把同一主题下的其他话题当成本文重点。
questions.evidence: Scotland has ambitions to become an environmental leader, but its recycling rate has just fallen to a five-year low.

questions.prompt: What can differ between local recycling services?
options: Accepted materials, container systems and glass collection
Whether gravity acts on waste containers
The length of a calendar year
The chemical identity of every element

questions.evidence: Depending on where someone lives, there can be differences in which materials are accepted, container types and colours and whether glass is collected at the kerbside.
